identity_note: Matched Long Lake Management Holdings, Inc. (llmh.com, 'Long Lake'), the General Catalyst-backed AI holding company led by Alex Taubman that bought Amex GBT. It is not Long Lake Insurance (a Saskatchewan brokerage), and it is not The Taubman Company, whose address is on Long Lake Rd in Bloomfield Hills, MI.

profile.name: Long Lake Management Holdings (Long Lake)
profile.description: Permanent-capital AI holding company that buys US services businesses and runs them on its Nexus AI platform, with forward-deployed engineers and operators embedded in each company. It closed a $6.3B take-private of American Express Global Business Travel in Sept 2026.
profile.location: New York, NY (Simplify HQ; offices in New York and San Francisco per llmh.com)
profile.founder: Alex (Alexander) Taubman, Co-Founder & CEO. Press names no other co-founder; the 'Zach Frankl' co-founder from the prior pass is still uncorroborated and is dropped.
profile.funding_detail: About $1.3B raised across 4 rounds (Dealroom, Simplify), the latest a $609M Series C in Nov 2025 (Simplify). Investors are General Catalyst, Alpha Wave, Thrive, D1, Elad Gil and Lightscape. The Amex GBT deal was co-financed by existing investors, Koch Equity Development, and a $1.5B first-lien term loan at the GBT level.
profile.past_completed_deals: Amex GBT take-private (~$6.3B, all cash, $9.50/share). Announced May 4, 2026, approved by stockholders Aug 3, 2026, completed Sep 29, 2026; GBT is delisted from NYSE. Before that, 'dozens' of services businesses per the company's release (secondary sources say 18 by late 2025, and 30+ or ~35 by 2026), concentrated in HOA management, construction and other services. Long Lake does not publish the names. Wold Architects (from the prior pass) could not be verified.
profile.open_role: M&A role, posted under the title "Finance" on the M&A team (deal execution from diligence to close plus post-close value creation; New York/SF), open as of 2026-10-08 (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/long-lake/0449fd29-8278-4c90-aaa6-9ad4490a20f6)

verdict.headline: M&A deal-execution seat still open · just closed $6.3B Amex GBT
verdict.detail: The M&A posting (first published May 13, 2026, now titled 'Finance' under the M&A team) is live on Ashby. It covers diligence through close and then value creation alongside management.
